propositions: Three identical O_EXCL/stamped_file_is_stale acquire loops exist across enrich_drain, compact_trigger, and gc_trigger, creating duplication and inconsistency
Release semantics differ: enrich_drain wraps close and unlink in one try block (leaking locks on close failure), while compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try blocks (always unlink)
Stamp bytes differ (drain appends newline, others do not) but are invisible to readers that strip, requiring canonicalization

Logging and holder description differ across the three workers, with drain's holder naming pinned to doctor_locks by test_drain_and_doctor_describe_a_holderless_lock_identically and requiring preservation
Consolidate all three acquire/release pairs into src/rebar/_store/stamped_lock.py with unified semantics (two-block release, no-newline stamp, configurable holder description callback)
Guard criterion os.O_CREAT AND stamped_file_is_stale identifies exactly the three copies without false positives in unrelated O_EXCL uses or doctor_locks reader
